entities.name: SSBP3 rat Q9R050
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Rattus norvegicus SSBP3 (361 aa).
Annotated nuclear protein; may bind single-stranded polypyrimidine DNA and participate in transcription regulation, including COL1A2 promoter regulation.
Predicted Pfam domains: LisH_SSDP (residues 20–73) and SSDP (residues 81–338).
Sequence-derived properties: 37.7 kDa, pI 6.44, GRAVY −0.637; composition is polar/acidic overall and proline/glycine-rich in the C-terminal region.
